title: Current season (draft 0.2.0)
description: The season the site shows: boss, schedule, raid state and the end-of-season survey. The private engine writes it to the outbox whenever any of these change; the site renders the countdown and the state from it. All times are UTC. While the season before it still takes final results, it travels along as `previous`.

state.description: upcoming: before starts_at. live: the raid is running. measuring: the raid has ended and the final border is still being measured and graded. closed: graded and final.

survey.description: The end-of-season survey, which stays on Tally. null until the season's form exists. The site links to it only after the raid has ended, and only between opens_at and closes_at.

previous.description: The season before this one, published only while its final-results window may still be open: from its close until its survey's closes_at, or END + 20 days 23:59 JST before the form exists. The site keeps taking that season's final results through this window after the next season is published. Absent otherwise.

utc.description: ISO 8601 in UTC, with a Z suffix.

survey.description: A season's survey on Tally, or null until its form exists.

url.description: Must be a Tally form: the site renders it as a link, so nothing else is accepted.
